SCRIPT M-Cn Hi, Ling. Im calling about the apartments you showed me last week. W-Am Hello, Jinyu. Did you like any of them? M-Cn Yes, l liked the one that was outside of town. It was so big—I would love to have that extra space. My current place is too small. W-Am Oh, unfortunately, that apartment's already been rented. But there's another one available in the same neighborhood, and it's nice and big. Would you like me to book a showing? M-Cn Yes, please! I'm available every morning this week.

SCRIPT M-Au We're getting a shipment of medical equipment today. The new autorefractor machines for eye exams are coming in. W-Br Great. They're going to make our patients' exams much more accurate. M-Au l can unpack them when they get here. W-Br That's OK. Just put them in the storage closet overnight. A company representative is coming in tomorrow, and we'll need them then. M-Au What time is the representative coming? W-Br He's coming at six p.m. after the clinic closes. He'll be showing us how to use the new equipment.

SCRIPT M-Au Hi, Liliana. I've only worked here at the factory for six months, but I'm wondering if it's possible to change positions. You've been here quite a while. What do you think? W-Am Good! I definitely encourage you to work your way up. l'll celebrate fifteen years of employment here next month. M-Au Congratulations! Right now I'm working as a package handler, but I'd like to be an assembly technician. What do I need to do? W-Am Well, the first step would be to talk to your supervisor. He'll be able to give you more details. M-Au Thanks. Actually, I think he's in his office now.

SCRIPT M-Cn Hi. My name is Hector Murray, and I'm a customer at your bank. I'm calling about getting a small-business loan. My business is expanding, and I need an additional vehicle. W-Br Sure, we can help you with that. We'll need some financial information—your updated business plan, bank statements, and income and payroll tax statements. M-Cn OK. Should I make an appointment to go over the information with you in person? W-Br No, there's no need to come in. You can just fill out our online application form. I'll send you the link.

SCRIPT W-Br Hi, Mr. Schneider. Thanks for agreeing to show me around your new facility. lt will, really help me with the article I'm writing. I think my magazine's readers will enjoy learning about indoor hydroponic farming. M-Au It's my pleasure. When we grow plants in water rather than soil, we actually end up needing much less water to grow the same amount of food. That surprises most people. W-Br Interesting. I'll be sure to include that information. By the way, is it all right if I take some pictures of your setup? I brought a camera. M-Au Of course. Let's get started.

SCRIPT M-Au Ms. Becker, I've walked around your property, and I think your home's a good candidate for solar panels. I can probably install them next month. W-Br Great! But aren't there too many trees around my house? M-Au Well, there's a spot in your back garden that gets enough sunlight to put some solar panels— if you cut just a few of the branches off that maple tree. W-Br That tree's actually on my neighbors' property, so I'd better make sure it's OK. i'll ask them later. By the way, my garage is pretty small, so I'm concerned about the size of the ten-kilowatt battery that goes with the panels. Can you look in there to make sure it'll fit?

SCRIPT M-Au Astrid and Ulrike, do you have a few minutes before the lunch crowd arrives? W-Am Sure, Mr. Smith. ls this about our new menu? M-Au No, not that. The refrigerator near the chef's station wasn't closed properly last night. W-Am Oh no—I think that was me. I put the leftover salad in there. W-Br And I should have checked to make sure it was shut before closing the restaurant. M-Au It's OK, but a repair person's coming to see if there's something that can be done to make it easier to close securely. I have to go to the bank, so could you let him in when he arrives and help him out?

SCRIPT W-Br: Hi, Adem. During one part of our market research team meeting tomorrow, we'll need to share some information about recent consumer trends. Could you create some attractive slides with this information? M-Cn: Fabrice is exceptionally good with graphics. W-Br: Oh, in that case, let me ask him. M-Cn: But, as promised, I have started looking closely at what our competitors are doing to attract clients. So after lunch today, I can share some ideas with you about how we might incorporate those strategies in our own work. W-Br: Great. I definitely want to hear more about that!

SCRIPT W-Am It's almost eleven o'clock. I'm worried that we'll fall behind schedule. We need to have the drywall installed in this house by tomorrow. M-Au Don't worry. The delivery truck just pulled up in front a few minutes ago. W-Am OK, that's a relief. Let's head outside. M-Cn Hi—I'm Gregor. Apologies for the delay. Traffic was an absolute nightmare on Route 37 North. Where should I unload the materials? M-Au You'll need to maneuver your truck over to the back entrance. M-Cn That won't be a problem. Could one of you guide me in? W-Am Sure, I'll do it. It's a tight spot, so just keep me in sight in your rearview mirror.

SCRIPT W-Br Hi. I'm here for the two o'clock weight lifting class, but there's no one in the studio. M-Au That class was canceled. SCRIPT M-Au Thanks for helping me with this service event. I'm so glad we'll finally have a reading area in our community center. SCRIPT W-Br Hi. My company is having a holiday party today, and I'd like to buy a cake. What do you have available? M-Cn We have a cake menu with some different options. SCRIPT M-Au Hello, listeners, and welcome to my podcast! With me today is the national chess champion, Olga Popova. Just last month, Olga successfully defended her title for the second time. So, the fact that she is just twenty-one years old is especially impressive. She's still the youngest national champion ever. Olga recently signed a lucrative deal to promote her favorite energy drink. I'll start our discussion today by asking her to tell us a little more about that.

SCRIPT W-Am Thanks for stopping by our booth to learn more about career opportunities at Mosconi Accounting. We've been in business for over three decades. One of the things I most appreciate about working for this company is that employees are allowed to make their own work schedules. We're looking for job candidates with five or more years of experience. lf you think you're a strong candidate, please sign up for an interview on one of the tablets on the table in front of you.

SCRIPT M-Au Ladies and gentlemen, the play will begin soon. Please note that Arnaud Clement will not appear in tonight's performance. The role of Mr. Bertrand will be played by his understudy, Olivier Lambert. We apologize for this last-minute change. There will be a twenty-minute intermission between the first and second acts. Refreshments will be available in the lobby at that time. Now, please take a moment to silence your mobile phones and any other electronic devices. We hope that you enjoy tonight's performance!

SCRIPT W-Br Hi, Babatunde. The storm last night brought down some branches onto Trent Avenue, and no cars can get through. There's debris from the storm on some other roadways as well, but that's the main route into the city center. Make sure to take a bucket truck and a few additional service people with you. Oh, and remember that we have a meeting with a roadway maintenance director at three o'clock. She wants to discuss some tasks for an upcoming repaving project.

SCRIPT W-Am As lifeguards here at the pool, you'll each begin your shift by checking the pool's chemical balance. This task is important because it ensures our pool equipment stays in good condition and doesn't corrode. Here's how it's done: take a test strip from this box, then hold the strip in the water, like this, for about five seconds. The color will tell you whether the pH level is within acceptable range. A blue color on this strip indicates that the water is OK. Now I’ll show you where we store the chemicals in case you need them later. I hope we have the chemical supplies you're looking for and make sure you know the safety regulations.

SCRIPT M-Cn Thank you, Fritz, for having me on your podcast to introduce my new movie. I decided to direct this film because it's an inspiring story. People will get to learn about the bravery and survival strategies needed for an expedition to a place with extremely cold conditions. The Ice Fall's expedition of 1901 took place back in a time without the sort of equipment and instruments we have today. Is the film 100 percent accurate? Well, we have no way of knowing everything that happened. But we did use information from diaries kept by the Ice Fall's crew. The film is about their challenging journey and personal sacrifices for a scientific discovery.

SCRIPT W-Am As the mayor of our city, l'd like to thank you for joining us to celebrate the first day of construction for the Garfield Bridge. In less than two years, the ground we're all standing on right now will be the entrance to the south end of the bridge, linking the communities on both sides of the river. Not only will the bridge be functional—it'll also be attractive. Asako Tamura, who designed the famous Molina Bridge, was our principal architect. Now, l'd like to invite Ms. Tamura to be the first person to sign the ceremonial shovel, which will be used to initiate construction.

SCRIPT M-Cn Thanks for signing up for this guided hike in Kiftaynee State Park. Our park includes several sites of archaeological interest that have attracted a lot of attention. This afternoon's hike on Vista Trail will take us through areas where our early ancestors lived and farmed long ago. l know that some of you expressed interest in the Claremont Trail. That's quite a long hike, and remember, our park closes at four. If you'd like to go on that hike on a future date, then please arrive during the morning. Also, for those of you who think you'll be back often, consider buying a yearly pass. It'll be cheaper than paying for each visit.

SCRIPT W-Br l've been going through all our bills and identifying where our business can cut costs. We can certainly be smarter about some purchases, and we can also work to keep our electricity bill down. lt's never exceeded 300 euros a month before, but it did once this year. I was surprised to see that. I think the biggest savings, however, will come from approaching our long-term suppliers about lowering their prices. l'll spend some time this afternoon investigating what other suppliers charge. If I find better prices, we'll have more negotiating power.

SCRIPT W-Am Good morning! Thank you for visiting our booth at the trade show. Today, I'm going to demonstrate how to use the Gregerson Quickblast to steam your vegetables to perfection. Let's start with some fresh asparagus. For this recipe, you'll need asparagus spears, a tablespoon of butter, a pinch of salt, and water. Bring the water, butter, and salt to a boil. Place the vegetables in the top half of the device. Now, set the timer for the recommended cook time. While we wait, please take a coupon for a twenty percent discount on the Quickblast at any local store.

Centre Touts New Adventure

TORONTO (28 May)—The trustees of Toronto's Earth and Space Centre announced the opening of an exciting new educational film. The two-hour immersive experience called Out of This World explains through live footage, interviews, and first-rate animation what the next outer-space missions might involve with respect to both vehicles and people.

Out of This World will be presented on the Envelop system, which has been installed in the theatre and is now undergoing testing and fine-tuning. The system promises to delight the senses, not only through vivid visuals but also through superb, lifelike sound projected to the listeners from all sides.

Single-ticket prices for adults and special rates for youngsters, families, and school groups will be announced soon. The anticipated public debut for the programme is 1 July.

ENCINO PASS (March 11)—Encino Pass Airport officials have announced that Rapido Airline will begin offering flights in and out of Encino Pass this summer. Rapido joins Gamma Air and Southern Skylines in serving the regional airport.

     As the city of Encino Pass has grown in recent years, Encino Pass Airport has seen increased air traffic, despite being the smallest airport in the state. With flights to Encino Pass regularly booked to capacity, travelers often had to use other regional airports. The Encino Pass Airport and the city council have both been working to attract more airlines to the area to better accommodate the increase in the number of travelers.

     “Rapido Airline was our top choice as an expansion airline,” said Encino Pass Mayor Chris Donovan. “It is known for offering low fares, maintaining on-time schedules, and surpassing safety inspections. We're pleased that it has decided to join us here in Encino Pass. This addition will expand options and make air travel more convenient for residents and visitors alike.”

     The city and airport are also in talks to provide shuttle bus service between the airport and surrounding parking facilities, refurbish the rental car booths, and add another terminal to the airport. The negotiations are part of the city's long-term plan to increase tourism in the area.

     Rapido Airline's flights between Encino Pass and Summerset begin on July 9, with more routes to be added later in the month.

Yum and Walk Food Tours Adding a New Destination

COLLEGE STATION (May 15)—On June 2, Yum and Walk Food Tours will add College Station to its statewide list of culinary destinations.

     “College Station has been overlooked as a culinary destination for too long,” said tour-company owner Ed Lopez. A former chef, Lopez also once worked as a journalist and wrote about cuisine for the Texas Beacon.

     Yum and Walk Food Tours offers outings in nine other cities in Texas and brings visitors to restaurants, bakeries, and specialty stores to sample both sweet and savory treats. Visitors walk through the city with an experienced guide, who also shares information about each neighborhood's history. Mr. Lopez himself will serve as the tour guide in College Station, his home before working in San Antonio and then returning to the area.

     “From the beginning, my goal has been to help people discover great food,” said Mr. Lopez.

     The local itinerary includes five stops in a three-hour time span—Giuseppina's Trattoria, Yucatan Plate, Kerala Kebabs, Spice Rub Stop, and Delicious Doughnuts. Customers can schedule private tours if they have any specific dietary preferences or requirements.

     Local officials are excited about the tour company's move into the area.

     “We're thrilled to have Yum and Walk Food Tours add us to their list of destinations,” said College Station Mayor Maria Garcia. “Their presence is sure to have a positive impact on our area's dining establishments.”

     Tickets are $50 each. The ten-week touring season begins on July 2 and lasts until September 3. Tours take place on Sundays from 1 P.M. to 4 P.M.

We will soon host a group of employees from Seongnam Electronics. — [1] —. They will arrive on November 10 and be with us for a week to observe our research and production methods. We encourage everyone to interact with the visitors while they are here. — [2] —.

Thank you,

Janice Capaldi, Director of Operations, Dolesley Electronics, Inc.

Review: Pizza in Bobbingworth
Submitted by: Gerard Landis

★★★★☆

There is a new pizza restaurant in town called Maple Pizza House. Not to my surprise, it offers a number of signature pizzas with maple flavoring, including dessert pizzas. While I personally did not like the maple-flavored pizza at all, the rest of my party enjoyed a large maple-ham pizza as a main course. The others in my group also devoured the maple-walnut dessert pizza, which, to me, tasted like an overly sweet, sticky pie.

Fortunately for me, the menu includes some pizzas that do not have maple flavoring. I ordered a traditional cheese pizza. It was served piping hot and was delicious. Because there were tasty menu options that pleased everyone, I rate the Maple Pizza House 4 stars out of 5, and I would recommend visiting.

RHC Continues to Impress

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

Contact: Dora Su, +65 0555 1294

SINGAPORE (3 August)—In operation for five years, Rayder Holdings Corporation (RHC) is announcing the completion of its sixth renovation project, Bay Commons. The company, founded by real estate agents Rayna Wong and Derrick Lim, specializes in converting industrial buildings into apartment complexes.

“Turning commercial buildings into residential spaces has its challenges,” Ms. Wong said. “However, we are committed to repurposing buildings instead of constructing new ones.”

This commitment was recently cited in a speech by Yamina Badawi, Singapore’s minister of Housing and Urban Development, who applauded RHC’s contribution to the nation’s housing supply.

RHC completed its first conversion project four years ago—the Kallang Overlook apartment complex. Since then, RHC has completed five more projects: Aston Estates, Tampines Tower, Lakeside Manor, Yishun Terrace, and now Bay Commons.

“Bay Commons represents a departure from our previous projects,” Ms. Wong noted. “This housing complex is designed primarily for students at the nearby Changi Technological Institute.”

Units at Bay Commons are now available for rent or purchase, she added.

74. - Dẫn chứng: "We've been in business for over three decades." (Chúng tôi đã kinh doanh được hơn ba thập kỷ).
- Paraphrase: over three decades (hơn 3 thập kỷ) = It has been in business for a long time (Nó đã kinh doanh trong một thời gian dài).

questions.stem: What qualification does the speaker mention?
questions.explanation:
75. - Dẫn chứng: "We're looking for job candidates with five or more years of experience." (Chúng tôi đang tìm kiếm các ứng viên công việc có từ 5 năm kinh nghiệm trở lên).
- Paraphrase: five or more years of experience (5 năm kinh nghiệm trở lên) = Five years of experience (5 năm kinh nghiệm).

questions.stem: What does the speaker encourage the listeners to do?
questions.explanation:
76. - Dẫn chứng: "If you think you're a strong candidate, please sign up for an interview on one of the tablets on the table in front of you." (Nếu bạn nghĩ mình là một ứng viên tiềm năng, vui lòng đăng ký phỏng vấn trên một trong các máy tính bảng đặt trên bàn trước mặt bạn).
- Paraphrase: sign up for an interview (đăng ký phỏng vấn) = Sign up for an interview (Đăng ký một cuộc phỏng vấn).

questions.stem: Where is the announcement taking place?
questions.explanation:
77. - Dẫn chứng: "Ladies and gentlemen, the play will begin soon." (Thưa quý vị, vở kịch sẽ sớm được bắt đầu).

questions.stem: Why does the speaker apologize?

options.text: There will be a long wait time.

questions.explanation:
78. - Dẫn chứng: "We apologize for this last-minute change. Mr. Bertrand will be played by his understudy, Olivier Lambert." (Chúng tôi xin lỗi vì sự thay đổi vào phút chót này. Vai ông Bertrand sẽ được đảm nhận bởi diễn viên dự bị của ông ấy, Olivier Lambert).
- Paraphrase: played by his understudy (được đóng bởi diễn viên dự bị) = A replacement has been made (Một sự thay thế đã được thực hiện).

questions.stem: What does the speaker remind the listeners to do?
questions.explanation:
79. - Dẫn chứng: "Now, please take a moment to silence your mobile phones and any other electronic devices..." (Bây giờ, vui lòng dành chút thời gian để tắt tiếng điện thoại di động và bất kỳ thiết bị điện tử nào khác...).
- Paraphrase: silence your mobile phones (tắt tiếng điện thoại di động) = Silence their electronic devices (Tắt tiếng các thiết bị điện tử của họ).

questions.stem: According to the speaker, why is Trent Avenue closed?

options.text: It is blocked by fallen branches.
A traffic light has stopped working.

- Paraphrase: no cars can get through (không xe nào qua được) = It is blocked by fallen branches (Nó bị chặn bởi cành cây đổ).

questions.stem: What does the speaker imply when she says, “that’s the main route into the city center’’?

options.text: She will take a different route.
Funding will be made available soon.
A task should be given priority.

questions.explanation:
81. - Dẫn chứng: "There's debris from the storm on some other roadways as well, but that's the main route into the city center." (Cũng có những mảnh vụn từ cơn bão trên một số con đường khác, nhưng đó là tuyến đường chính dẫn vào trung tâm thành phố).
- Paraphrase: that's the main route into the city center (đó là tuyến đường chính vào trung tâm) = A task should be given priority (Một nhiệm vụ nên được ưu tiên).

questions.stem: According to the speaker, what is scheduled for three o’clock?
questions.explanation:
82. - Dẫn chứng: "I'm worried that we'll fall behind schedule... we have a meeting with a roadway maintenance director at three o'clock." (Tôi lo lắng rằng chúng ta sẽ bị chậm lịch trình... chúng ta có cuộc họp với giám đốc bảo trì đường bộ lúc ba giờ).
- Paraphrase: meeting with a roadway maintenance director (họp với giám đốc bảo trì) = A meeting with a supervisor (Một cuộc họp với người giám sát).

questions.stem: Where are the instructions being given?
questions.explanation:
83. - Dẫn chứng: "This task is important because each begin your shift by checking the pool's chemical balance." (Nhiệm vụ này quan trọng vì mỗi người bắt đầu ca làm việc của mình bằng việc kiểm tra sự cân bằng hóa chất của hồ bơi).
- Paraphrase: pool's chemical balance (cân bằng hóa chất hồ bơi) = In a laboratory (Trong một phòng thí nghiệm - Lưu ý: Dựa trên ngữ cảnh kiểm tra chỉ số hóa chất).

questions.stem: According to the speaker, why is a task important?

options.text: It keeps equipment in good condition.

questions.explanation:
84. - Dẫn chứng: "It ensures our pool equipment stays in good condition and doesn't corrode." (Nó đảm bảo thiết bị hồ bơi của chúng ta luôn trong tình trạng tốt và không bị ăn mòn).
- Paraphrase: pool equipment stays in good condition (thiết bị hồ bơi ở tình trạng tốt) = It keeps equipment in good condition (Nó giữ cho thiết bị trong tình trạng tốt).

questions.stem: What will the listeners do next?

options.text: See where some supplies are stored
Learn how to operate a machine
Review a list of safety regulations

questions.explanation:
85. - Dẫn chứng: "Now I'll show you where we store the chemicals in case you need them later." (Bây giờ tôi sẽ chỉ cho bạn nơi chúng tôi cất giữ hóa chất trong trường hợp bạn cần chúng sau này).
- Paraphrase: show you where we store the chemicals (chỉ cho bạn nơi cất hóa chất) = See where some supplies are stored (Xem nơi lưu trữ một số vật tư).

questions.stem: Who is the speaker?
questions.explanation:
86. - Dẫn chứng: "I'm Fritz, for having me on your podcast to introduce my new movie." (Tôi là Fritz, cảm ơn vì đã mời tôi lên podcast của bạn để giới thiệu bộ phim mới của tôi).
- Paraphrase: introduce my new movie (giới thiệu bộ phim mới) = A filmmaker (Một nhà làm phim).

questions.stem: What is the movie about?
questions.explanation:
87. - Dẫn chứng: "The Ice Fall's expedition of 1901 took place back in a time without the sort of equipment and instruments we have today." (Cuộc thám hiểm của Ice Fall năm 1901 diễn ra vào thời điểm không có loại thiết bị và dụng cụ mà chúng ta có ngày nay).
- Paraphrase: expedition of 1901 (cuộc thám hiểm năm 1901) = A historical expedition (Một cuộc thám hiểm lịch sử).

questions.stem: What does the speaker mean when he says, “we have no way of knowing everything that happened”?

options.text: A story is not entirely factual.

questions.explanation:
88. - Dẫn chứng: "Is the film 100 percent accurate? Well, we have no way of knowing everything that happened." (Bộ phim có chính xác 100% không? Chà, chúng ta không có cách nào biết được mọi chuyện đã xảy ra).
- Paraphrase: no way of knowing everything (không cách nào biết hết mọi thứ) = A story is not entirely factual (Một câu chuyện không hoàn toàn là sự thật).

questions.stem: What event is being held?
questions.explanation:
89. - Dẫn chứng: "I’d like to thank you for joining us to celebrate the first day of construction for the Garfield Bridge." (Tôi muốn cảm ơn các bạn đã cùng chúng tôi kỷ niệm ngày đầu tiên khởi công xây dựng cầu Garfield).
- Paraphrase: first day of construction (ngày đầu khởi công) = A project launch ceremony (Một lễ khởi động dự án).

questions.stem: Who is Asako Tamura?
questions.explanation:

(Bây giờ, tôi muốn mời bà Tamura là người đầu tiên ký vào chiếc xẻng nghi lễ... Bà Tamura, người đã thiết kế cây cầu Molina nổi tiếng...).
- Paraphrase: who designed (người đã thiết kế) = An architect (Một kiến trúc sư).

questions.stem: What does the speaker invite Asako Tamura to do?
questions.explanation:
91. - Dẫn chứng: "91I'd like to invite Ms. Tamura to be the first person to sign the ceremonial shovel" (Tôi muốn mời bà Tamura là người đầu tiên ký vào chiếc xẻng nghi lễ).
- Paraphrase: sign the ceremonial shovel (ký vào xẻng nghi lễ) = Sign her name (Ký tên cô ấy).

questions.stem: What does the speaker point out about Kiftaynee State Park?

options.text: It is the largest in the region.
It is maintained entirely by volunteers.

questions.explanation:
92. - Dẫn chứng: "Our park includes several sites of archaeological interest that have attracted a lot of attention." (Công viên của chúng tôi bao gồm một số địa điểm khảo cổ thú vị đã thu hút nhiều sự chú ý).
- Paraphrase: sites of archaeological interest (địa điểm khảo cổ) = It has unique archaeological sites (Nó có các địa điểm khảo cổ độc đáo).

questions.stem: Why does the speaker say, “our park closes at four”?

To announce a change in park hours
To indicate why a trail is not an option
To emphasize that camping is not permitted

questions.explanation:
93. - Dẫn chứng: "93know that ancestors lived and farmed long ago... our park closes at four" (biết rằng tổ tiên đã sống và trồng trọt từ lâu... công viên đóng cửa lúc 4 giờ).
- Paraphrase: park closes at four (công viên đóng cửa lúc 4 giờ) = To emphasize that camping is not permitted (Để nhấn mạnh rằng việc cắm trại không được phép).

questions.stem: What does the speaker encourage the listeners to buy?
questions.explanation:
94. - Dẫn chứng: "94for those of you who think you'll be back often, consider buying a yearly pass. It'll be cheaper than paying for each visit." (cho những ai nghĩ rằng mình sẽ quay lại thường xuyên, hãy cân nhắc mua thẻ năm. Nó sẽ rẻ hơn trả tiền mỗi lần đi).
- Paraphrase: buying a yearly pass (mua thẻ năm) = An annual pass (Một chiếc thẻ năm).

questions.stem: What is the speaker mainly discussing?

options.text: How to be more environmentally friendly

questions.explanation:
95. - Dẫn chứng: "We've been going through all our bills and identifying where our business can cut costs." (Chúng tôi đã xem xét tất cả các hóa đơn và xác định nơi doanh nghiệp có thể cắt giảm chi phí).
- Paraphrase: cut costs (cắt giảm chi phí) = Ways to reduce expenses (Các cách để giảm chi phí).

questions.stem: Look at the graphic. Which month does the speaker refer to?
questions.explanation:
96. - Dẫn chứng: "96It's never exceeded 300 euros a month before, but it did once this year." (Nó chưa bao giờ vượt quá 300 euro một tháng trước đây, nhưng năm nay đã bị một lần).
- Paraphrase: exceeded 300 euros (vượt quá 300 euro) = July (Tháng 7 - Dựa trên biểu đồ, tháng 7 là tháng duy nhất vượt mức 300).

questions.stem: What will the speaker do this afternoon?
questions.explanation:
97. - Dẫn chứng: "97I'll spend some time this afternoon investigating what other suppliers charge." (Tôi sẽ dành thời gian chiều nay để tìm hiểu mức giá của các nhà cung cấp khác).
- Paraphrase: investigating what other suppliers charge (tìm hiểu giá nhà cung cấp khác) = Conduct some research (Thực hiện nghiên cứu).

questions.stem: What type of product is the speaker demonstrating?
questions.explanation: "98. - Dẫn chứng: ""Today, I'm going to demonstrate how to use the Gregerson Quickblast to steam your vegetables to perfection."" (Hôm nay, tôi sẽ hướng dẫn cách sử dụng máy Gregerson Quickblast để hấp rau củ của bạn một cách hoàn hảo).Paraphrase: steam your vegetables (hấp rau củ của bạn) = A food steamer (Một chiếc máy hấp thực phẩm)."

questions.stem: Look at the graphic. How long will the ingredient be cooked?
questions.explanation:
99. - Dẫn chứng: "Place the vegetables in the... Today we're cooking Brussels sprouts." (Cho rau củ vào... Hôm nay chúng ta sẽ nấu mầm cải Brussels).
- Paraphrase: Brussels sprouts (mầm cải Brussels) = 4 minutes (4 phút - Dựa trên bảng thời gian nấu Cook Time, món Brussels sprouts cần 4 phút).

questions.stem: What does the speaker offer the listeners?
questions.explanation:
100. - Dẫn chứng: "100please take a coupon for a twenty percent discount on the Quickblast at any local store." (vui lòng lấy phiếu giảm giá 20% cho dòng Quickblast tại bất kỳ cửa hàng địa phương nào).
- Paraphrase: twenty percent discount (giảm giá 20%) = A discount coupon (Một phiếu giảm giá).

questions.stem: The building contract was ------- awarded to Zhong Builders of Manchester.
questions.explanation: Dựa vào trạng từ chỉ thời gian, "recently" (gần đây) là từ phù hợp nhất để mô tả việc hợp đồng xây dựng vừa được trao cho đơn vị thầu.

questions.stem: A small salad is included with the lunch special ------- Wednesday.
questions.explanation: "Every" (mỗi) được dùng để chỉ sự lặp lại của sự kiện vào một ngày cụ thể trong tuần (mỗi thứ Tư).

questions.stem: Mapsoar Airways redesigned its seats to make it much ------- to recline them.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc so sánh hơn "make it + adj-er + to do sth" được dùng khi có từ "much" bổ nghĩa phía trước để nhấn mạnh sự thay đổi.

questions.stem: Employees may visit the company cafeteria on weekday evenings ------- 8:00 P.M.
questions.explanation: Giới từ "until" (cho đến khi) dùng để chỉ mốc thời gian kết thúc của một hoạt động diễn ra liên tục.

questions.stem: Mr. Yang sent one copy of his resume but was asked to bring ------- to his interview.
questions.explanation: "Another" (một cái khác) là đại từ thay thế cho "another copy" để tránh lặp từ "copy" đã xuất hiện trước đó.

questions.stem: Once payment ------- are submitted, it takes several days for any corporate expenditures to be approved.
questions.explanation: Cụm từ "payment requests" (yêu cầu thanh toán) là một thuật ngữ phổ biến trong quy trình kế toán doanh nghiệp.

questions.stem: The Outsourced Kitchen Company’s cross-back apron is ------- by chefs around the world.
questions.explanation: "Favored" (được ưa chuộng) đóng vai trò là tính từ/phân từ bị động, mô tả trạng thái của chiếc tạp dề đối với các đầu bếp.

questions.stem: Mr. Toskala was able to ------- an agreement with the supplier for lower-cost replacement parts.
questions.explanation: Cụm từ "reach an agreement" (đạt được một thỏa thuận) là một collocation (cụm từ cố định) chuẩn trong tiếng Anh thương mại.

questions.stem: Lucior Shoes saw a ------- in expenses after adjusting its production processes.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống đứng sau mạo từ "a", cần một danh từ. "Drop" (sự sụt giảm) phù hợp để nói về chi phí sau khi điều chỉnh quy trình.

questions.stem: Ms. Easley was asked to limit ------- to two 10-minute breaks per day.
questions.explanation: Động từ "limit" cần một tân ngữ, và trong ngữ cảnh này, "herself" (chính cô ấy) là đại từ phản thân bổ nghĩa cho chủ ngữ Ms. Easley.

questions.stem: Since the Orchid Ridge Hotel is in a remote area, the Web site includes a map and detailed -------.
questions.explanation: Do khách sạn nằm ở khu vực hẻo lánh (remote area), trang web cần cung cấp "directions" (chỉ dẫn đường đi) cho khách hàng.

questions.stem: Ms. Dolin ------- requested that order number 42 be hand delivered to avoid breakage.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống đứng giữa chủ ngữ và động từ chính "requested", cần một trạng từ "specifically" (một cách cụ thể) để bổ nghĩa.

questions.stem: Gahee's Market is located ------- the northeast corner of Welsh Avenue and Zilla Drive.
questions.explanation: Giới từ "at" được dùng để chỉ một địa điểm cụ thể hoặc một góc đường (at the corner).

questions.stem: ------- of Hamilton County are looking forward to the restored waterfront promenade.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống làm chủ ngữ của câu, cần một danh từ chỉ người số nhiều để đi với động từ "are looking forward to".

questions.stem: The Wakeshuka Manufacturing Council is made up of regional factory leaders ----- help set industry standards.
questions.explanation: "Who" là đại từ quan hệ dùng để thay thế cho danh từ chỉ người "factory leaders" và làm chủ ngữ cho động từ "help".

questions.stem: Inquiries regarding long-term advertising contracts should be ------- to Juan Mendes in the sales department.
questions.explanation: "Addressed to" (được gửi đến/hướng đến) là cụm từ chuẩn khi nói về việc chuyển các thắc mắc đến một người phụ trách cụ thể.

questions.stem: Interns at Biocorps ------- participated in the collection and analysis of water samples from the city reservoir.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ "eagerly" (một cách hăng hái/nhiệt tình) mô tả thái độ tích cực của các thực tập sinh khi tham gia thu thập mẫu.

questions.stem: Mr. Melo argued that Vantimore’s inventory tracking system is too -------.
questions.explanation: Sau trạng từ chỉ mức độ "too", cần một tính từ. "Complex" (phức tạp) mô tả đặc điểm của hệ thống theo dõi hàng tồn kho.

questions.stem: Years of experience in the industry is the most ------- factor in predicting one’s success in a supervisory role.
questions.explanation: "Valuable factor" (yếu tố quý giá/quan trọng) là cụm từ mang nghĩa tích cực phù hợp nhất để nói về kinh nghiệm trong ngành.

questions.stem: Iron Nail Hardware sells a wide ------- of kitchen and bathroom fixtures.
questions.explanation: Cụm từ "a wide variety of" (nhiều loại đa dạng cái gì đó) là một cấu trúc cực kỳ phổ biến trong TOEIC.

questions.stem: The popular Zeni Flex athletic shoes are sold ------- at Sports Now Shops.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ "exclusively" (độc quyền/chỉ có tại) thường dùng để chỉ việc một sản phẩm chỉ được bán tại một hệ thống cửa hàng nhất định.

questions.stem: The newest Paia’s Pasta House operates as a delivery-only restaurant, ------- its older locations continue to offer dine-in service.
questions.explanation: "Whereas" (trong khi đó) là liên từ dùng để chỉ sự đối lập giữa hai vế câu (một nơi chỉ giao hàng, nơi khác vẫn phục vụ tại chỗ).

questions.stem: ------- three weeks of completing the training sessions, the factory workers’ efficiency improved by 24 percent.
questions.explanation: Giới từ "Within" (trong vòng) dùng để chỉ một khoảng thời gian mà trong đó một sự thay đổi hoặc kết quả xảy ra.

questions.stem: A portfolio of promising uniform designs was submitted to the client for -------.
questions.explanation: Danh từ "evaluation" (sự đánh giá) phù hợp nhất với ngữ cảnh nộp các mẫu thiết kế để khách hàng xem xét và đưa ra nhận xét.

questions.stem: The sales representatives ------- samples of the company’s latest medications to doctors’ offices throughout the region.
questions.explanation: "Will be distributing" (sẽ đang phân phối) ở thì Tương lai tiếp diễn chỉ một kế hoạch hoặc hành động sẽ diễn ra trong tương lai.

questions.stem: Performing regular maintenance on your delivery vehicles will help prevent service disruptions and ------- emergency repairs.
questions.explanation: Tính từ "costly" (tốn kém) bổ nghĩa cho "emergency repairs" tạo thành nghĩa "những sửa chữa khẩn cấp tốn kém".

questions.stem: Despite past business failures, Mr. Bharati ------- and now runs a successful shipping operation.
questions.explanation: Động từ "persevered" (kiên trì) phù hợp để nói về việc ông Bharati vượt qua những thất bại trong quá khứ để thành công.

questions.stem: Mr. Chen spoke -------, and his material was very well organized.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống bổ nghĩa cho động từ "spoke", cần một trạng từ. "Distinctly" (rõ ràng) mô tả cách nói chuyện dễ hiểu.

questions.stem: Ms. Marcus is scheduled to arrive at City Station at 7:13 P.M. ------- her train is on time.
questions.explanation: Cụm "provided that" (miễn là/với điều kiện là) dùng để đưa ra một điều kiện cần thiết để sự việc chính xảy ra.

questions.stem: In the report, the researchers described the methodology they used in ------- their conclusions.
